create_multilabel_dataset: create a multilabel classification dataset with make_multilabel_classification using n_classes=2 and allow_unlabeled=True
run_multilabel_classification: run a multilabel classification pipeline with OneVsRestClassifier and linear SVC on synthetic data
run_dimensionality_reduction: run PCA or CCA dimensionality reduction on multilabel classification data for visualization
plot_multilabel_subfigures: plot multilabel classification subfigures with PCA and CCA transforms side by side
plot_hyperplane_boundaries: plot separating hyperplane boundaries for each class in a multilabel classification problem
